title: He Bought a Failing Studio for $10 Million. It Became $7 Billion #shorts
description:
In 1986, Steve Jobs, fired from Apple, bought a small computer graphics company from George Lucas. It nearly bankrupted him, until Toy Story.
Follow for more stories of fortunes made overnight.
hook_text:
FIRED FROM APPLE,
HE BOUGHT A STUDIO FOR $10 MILLION
first_comment: Genius bet or pure luck? Would you have kept funding a studio that burned money for ten years? 👇

lines.text: In 1985, Steve Jobs was fired from the company he founded.
So he bought a small computer graphics studio from George Lucas.
It was called Pixar, and it lost money every single year.
Jobs kept pouring in his own fortune just to pay the salaries.
Ten years later, he was nearly out of patience.
Then, in 1995, came Toy Story, the first fully computer-animated movie.
One week later, Pixar went public.
In a single day, Jobs's stake was worth over one billion dollars.
In 2006, Disney bought Pixar for seven billion dollars.
Follow for more stories of fortunes made overnight.
